name: Helius
tagline: Solana RPC, DAS NFT/token APIs, and webhooks for Solana apps
description: Helius provides Solana-first infrastructure including high-performance RPC, Digital Asset Standard (DAS) APIs for NFTs and tokens, enhanced transactions, and webhooks. Developers use it to power wallets, marketplaces, indexers, and on-chain apps without running their own Solana nodes.

auth.details: API key via query parameter ?api-key=YOUR_API_KEY or Authorization header; self-serve signup at dashboard.helius.dev

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free tier with limited credits (confirm on pricing page)
pricing.paid_plans: Developer, Business, Professional, and Enterprise plans with higher credit allowances

rate_limits: Credit-based limits vary by plan; not a simple fixed RPS for all endpoints
use_cases: query NFT metadata via DAS API
subscribe to on-chain webhooks for transactions
get enhanced transaction history for a wallet
call Solana JSON-RPC methods with API key
